policy: Reorganization may remove repeated boilerplate and the historical Wikipedia scaffold while preserving every topic as a dedicated section, every physical topic as an equation-bearing treatment, and at least 62 topic-specific physical mechanisms. Historical and interpretive annotations must not be assigned invented equations. Corpus-aligned public source links must resolve to topic-bearing local equation contexts joined to exact V2.1 source cards. Independently recovered original-paper displays must retain their locations, hashes and explicit non-alignment status and are counted separately. The full book must not be replaced by a synopsis or a list of topic names. Baseline reset on 2026-10-12 after the template sections and role overviews were replaced by worked treatments for every topic: topic words rose from 63,619 to 71,373 and displayed equation blocks from 129 to 379, while the PDF fell from 311 to 255 pages because repeated boilerplate was removed; the minima were raised for words, equations and topic-specific treatments.
